_comment: No sun at all -- the one word that empties the sky rather than describing what is in it.
`sun.absent` names the aspect in the parameter because the sun and the moon share the switch, and
`Word.reaching` only ever widens: an unqualified `absent` would reach both bodies, and a sunless
Age would lose its moon as well (Jonah, 2026-08-31).
The query is what makes it evocative as well as exact: an Age with no sun is a dark one, and the
word leans the rest of the draw that way rather than only blanking the body.
